identity.title: Recreational Marijuana Producer License — Tier II, Indoor

scan.summary: This is the OLCC's permit authorizing Evergreen Botanicals to produce recreational marijuana at its Bailey Hill location at a Tier II indoor capacity of 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy. The permit is the agency's legal authorization to operate; there is nothing in it to fix. The company must renew it before March 2, 2027, meet all five conditions stated on the permit, and hold evidence that it is doing so.
scan.freshness_note: The permit is current, issued March 3, 2026, and expires March 2, 2027. A renewal application and fee must reach the Commission no later than February 10, 2027 (20 days before expiry). Ask for a renewal confirmation once submitted.

conditions.title: Premises-specific license
conditions.evidence_expected: Proof the license is displayed at 2210 Bailey Hill Road where the public can see it

conditions.title: Annual renewal by deadline
conditions.evidence_expected: Dated receipt from OLCC confirming renewal application and fee received no later than February 10, 2027; copy of approved renewal

conditions.title: Cannabis Tracking System and worker permits
conditions.evidence_expected: CTS account showing all marijuana items tracked; current marijuana worker permits for all employees handling items; records of hire dates and permit issuance

conditions.title: Video surveillance compliance
conditions.evidence_expected: System meeting OAR 845-025-1450 specification (continuous 24/7 recording, 1280×720 px minimum, 10 fps, all required areas covered, 90-day rolling retention in approved format, real-time off-site backup); equipment failure logs; notification records to OLCC of any outage lasting 30+ minutes

conditions.title: Change reporting
conditions.evidence_expected: Written notice to OLCC submitted before any change in ownership, premises, or persons with financial interest; copies of notices and OLCC acknowledgments

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on all identity, date, and condition facts read directly from the permit. High confidence that OAR 845-025-1450 requires real-time off-site backup and 90-day retention (confirmed by web search). The permit itself is valid and has no gaps — it is the agency's document and all conditions are stated. Confidence is high that the video surveillance requirements now include real-time off-site backup (the rule was amended and older versions allowed on-site backup in a fire-rated room, but that is no longer an option). If the company's current video system stores backup on-site, it is now non-compliant. Renewal deadline is certain: 20 days before March 2, 2027 = February 10, 2027.
